list.name: Phase changes
list.query:
from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fsm_state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "phase")

targets.query:
from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "throughput")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "vpm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "queue")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "length")

from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "delay")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "avg_s")

from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fsm_state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "phase")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alerts")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> sum()
